title: Research: certify exact pending projectors for PR #2423's R438 rehosting

body:
## Change and mathematical scope

PR2423 proposes a rehosted R438 bit word but explicitly leaves its projector compatibility unchecked. This package binds its fixed selection and changed word to the actual pending subspaces: all 126,144 helper occurrences at 71,040 physical idle deadlines factor the original bit-address operator exactly. The new rank-34 remainder is the complement of the width-eight slice `[22,30)` inside child 6's `[22,64)` pending space.

This is a **finite geometric certificate and scoped proof**, with no new endpoint or κ claim. Every factor contains all or none of q-perp, so this account's PR1307 projector argument applies without choosing an orthonormal completion. The checker covers 111 rational port projectors, 12 factorization patterns and 170,496 exact basis columns, and binds all 32 replicas to those patterns. It independently recounts the changed local rank profile and recovers the predecessor's proposed 904,320-child global profile, rank mass 1,808,352 and deficit 10,272. All remainder charges remain paid.

Only `research/r438-rehost-projectors/` is added. See its README for the proof, exact boundaries and remaining obligations. PR2423 already checks numerical owner maps; that is acknowledged as predecessor work rather than claimed as a new census. This change adds their geometric/operator binding.

Still open: native changed-layout emission, source-bound complete hosted replay, local scalar/H1-H5 admission, correlated whole-call realization, injective cover compilation, all-size recursion, precision/tape and analytic transfer. No full theorem, formal proof, hosted-CI result or independent human review is claimed.

## Validation

CPython 3.12.3, Linux x86_64; standard library only. Passed:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/r438-rehost-projectors/verify.py
python3 -I -O -B research/r438-rehost-projectors/verify.py
python3 -I -B research/r438-rehost-projectors/test_verify.py
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/r438-rehost-projectors --check-only
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/r438-rehost-projectors
```

Expected final verifier output:

```text
PASS_R438_REHOST_PROJECTORS helpers=126144 deadlines=71040 ports=111 factorizations=12 controls=10 no_new_kappa
```

The registered replay runs normal and optimized receipt checks plus the five focused tests. A Git-free export using only declared inputs also passed under `-O`; actual source-byte and receipt-rank mutations were rejected by that exported command-line verifier. The selected-layout positive control reproduces 126,432 helper occurrences. The catalogue's R439 helper-star first example also passed (661 columns, eight controls).

Eight rejection controls cover source drift, missing/duplicate helpers, split q-perp, illegal chronology, omitted/duplicate rank-34 remainders, and an equal-rank wrong-exterior operator. Two exact witnesses distinguish equal-rank wrong-port and wrong-replica actions. The independent dense rational test checks the local block matrix; the full census binds every actual deadline to its checked pattern. Result receipts are read-only in normal execution.

Not run: native C++/Boost hosting, selected-frontier cold replay, the predecessor's slot optimizer/root engines, Lean, or the full physical multiplication machine. The supplied proof and tests do not discharge their inherited hypotheses.
